basic_info.description: Perched on the top floor of a charming two-unit Edwardian building, this spacious 2-bedroom, 1-bath home blends timeless character with thoughtful modern updates. Gorgeous period detailspicture rails, box beam and coved ceilings, wainscoting, built-in cabinetry, and refinished Douglas fir floorscreate warmth and elegance throughout.    The floorplan offers distinct living and dining rooms, ideal for both entertaining and everyday living. A split bath with a classic claw-foot tub adds vintage appeal, while the chef's kitchen delivers contemporary style and function with high-end appliances, custom cabinetry, and a peninsula for casual dining.    Enjoy the convenience of an in-unit laundry porch with washer and dryer, direct access to a lush shared garden, and abundant exclusive storage space. One-car parking completes this well-rounded home.    Set at the crossroads of Glen Park and Bernal Heights, you'll be moments from village shops, cafs, and transit, with easy access to BART, freeways, and neighborhood parks. A perfect blend of historic charm and modern comfort awaits.
